description: JVM backend-runtime conformance for the DEAL v1.2 slice (ISSUE-0106). JVM-only fixtures that run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac → java executing the emitted artifact (a bypassed codegen or JVM execution produces no output and fails the fixture). Covered v1.2 behaviors: the selected-entry main(): null non-async contract (the entry module must export main; the backend invokes it — pinned through the orchestrator multi-module pipeline with the runner auto-invoking the entry's zero-arity exports, main first in declaration order); Unicode scalar-value string for-of (one string containing exactly one scalar value per iteration — a supplementary character is ONE iteration); std/string scalar-value positions (length counts Unicode scalar values, substring positions are scalar values, empty-separator split yields one part per scalar value); and boundary string validation (a scalar-valid supplementary string crosses the table boundary; the emitted check helper rejects unpaired UTF-16 surrogates).

tests.name: jvm-v12-entry-main-invoked
tests.description: The selected entry module exports non-async main(): null and the backend invokes it: main's console.log output is observable through the emitted entry module (the runner invokes the entry's zero-arity exports in declaration order, main first)

tests.name: jvm-v12-entry-main-missing-rejected
tests.description: The v1.2 entry gate: a selected entry module that does not export main is rejected by the frontend with E2012 (the orchestrator selected-entry rule — ISSUE-0269 re-registration; E2012 carries the former E2010 entry-main-missing meaning) before any backend runs

tests.name: jvm-v12-entry-main-async-rejected
tests.description: The v1.2 entry gate: an async main violates the non-async signature requirement — E2011

modules.main.deal: export async function main(): null { return null; }

tests.name: jvm-v12-forof-scalar-iteration
tests.description: String for-of iterates Unicode scalar values: 'a😀b' yields exactly three iterations (the supplementary character is ONE scalar value), in order

tests.name: jvm-v12-std-string-scalar-length
tests.description: std/string.length measures Unicode scalar values: "hello" → 5, "" → 0, "héllo" → 5 (one scalar per accented character), "a😀b" → 3 (the supplementary character counts once)

tests.name: jvm-v12-std-string-scalar-substring
tests.description: std/string.substring positions are Unicode scalar values: over "a😀b" — (0,1) = "a", (1,2) = "😀", (2,3) = "b", and (0,3) is the whole string

tests.name: jvm-v12-std-string-split-empty-scalar
tests.description: std/string.split with an empty separator splits into individual Unicode scalar values: split("😀b", "") yields ["😀", "b"]

tests.name: jvm-v12-boundary-string-supplementary
tests.description: Boundary string validation: a scalar-valid string containing a supplementary character crosses the table-read boundary and reads back unchanged (the JVM representation contract — java.lang.String with no unpaired surrogates)

tests.name: jvm-v12-scalar-compare-supplementary
tests.description: String ordering compares Unicode scalar values: "😀" sorts after "z" (U+1F600 > U+007A), and equality is scalar-sequence equality
